mainEntity.name: How do I turn AI research findings into actual business decisions?

acceptedAnswer.text: Use AI to turn research into a prioritized experiment list, not an automatic business plan. Each recommendation should state the evidence, assumption, expected customer response, effort, risk, and success measure. Key factors include: - impact if correct - cost and time to test - reversibility - what result would change your mind. A landing-page or offer-positioning assistant can draft alternatives, but you should approve the offer, copy, targeting, and test design. Run one controlled change at a time when possible so the result remains interpretable.
acceptedAnswer.description: Convert each finding into a test with a stated assumption, evidence, action, effort, risk, and success measure. Prioritize low-cost, reversible experiments first. Review the proposed copy, offer, audience, and measurement plan before launch, then record what the result teaches you.
